parts.description: A light beige ceramic or stoneware bowl filled with a mixed salad containing leafy greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, red onions, olives, and feta cheese.
parts.reasoning: The object is a bowl containing food. For a rigid body simulation, we must treat the entire assembly (bowl + contents) as a single rigid body unless modeled otherwise, but since this is typically represented as a single static mesh, we base the physical properties on the dominant structural material: the ceramic/stoneware bowl. The bowl provides the external contact surface. The mass is estimated based on a standard medium-to-large ceramic bowl (approx 0.8 kg) plus the salad contents (approx 0.4 kg), totaling around 1.2 kg. The density is approximated based on ceramic. Friction and restitution values are typical for unglazed or lightly glazed ceramic surfaces, which are somewhat smooth but have moderate friction and low restitution.
